caseStudy.title: HarborLens
caseStudy.background:
HarborLens processes inspection photos from five ports. A Container Apps API accepts uploads, writes an ingestion record to Cosmos DB, then queues inference. Image jobs use PeekLock. The operations team needs safe retries and wants to start routing traffic to a replacement inference revision after it is ready.

Records have an id unique only within a port. Each port sends its update request with both identifiers. Image vectors are indexed separately and generated by a single model. Cached inference summaries may remain available for at most 300 seconds after the source changes.

The release team must keep the old revision available during rollout. During a spike, a worker completed its database write, then lost its message lock. The dashboard must show the duration of the slowest requests independently of average latency.

exhibits.title: Release settings
exhibits.code:
revisionMode: Multiple
traffic:
  - revisionName: intake--stable
    weight: 100
  - revisionName: intake--candidate
    weight: 0
::

options: Use VectorDistance with the image ID
Run a cross-partition scan by id
Point read with id img-341 and partition key dubai
